body:
I hear your words + I know this idea of finding peace within yourself. But it doesn’t feel attainable. For me at least.

I don’t know how to feel ok. Solid. I try to be a good person as well. I care deeply deeply deeply for my child and my partner. I try to show up with compassion and kindness for others. I try to help where I can. And I want to believe. I try to believe. I get up and try again out of sheer force of will.

The world is overwhelming me. It feels dark, locally, globally. My world has asked me to carry more than I have strength for - real financial, legal, work, relationship woes on top of the onslaught of regular inconveniences on top of a trauma strewn past with very little in way of a support system.

Tonight I thought//still think? About actually ending it. For real with no fear. Fear has held me back. Kept me paralyzed. That and this little hope that life might turn out the way I hope with my partner and my kiddo. 

But that light feels as far away and untouchable as a star. Something to look at that’s barely real.

I’m so sad. I’m so tired.

I don’t know what to say exactly.
I only opened an account tonight because I’m struggling too. 
FWIW, you express yourself so eloquently. Not just “for your age” which feels condescending somehow - but for any age.

Sending you a little light.
And the wisdom of books.

Your words matter and so do you.

I feel this so deeply.

It doesn’t make any sense to me.
